title: Certify a fixed-cut Type A QUERY pair correction (0% κ change)
body:
## Change and scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN. Exact conditional κ change 0%.** In exact signed #7113 on independently reproduced #7334, demote two Type A QUERYs to ordinary ADDs and solve the unique correction immediately before the first. All 17 existing J blocks stay fixed. Two exact engines exhaust six unit-body keys. Four fail the squared-defect gate. The one-key formal follow-up selects (1580,1659), whose exact operator is verified for all 17 formal body variables and all four phases, including 144 Gaussian Laurent basis columns. Pair (1516,1721) remains unresolved at the formal cap.

The verified correction needs two independent signed responses. The retained serial one-return QUERY interface, even with a higher Clifford rank on its one field, has phase-difference rank at most one under q-even scalar role setup and readout. The existing J lowering also carries a mandatory body transform. A mixed-sign adapter can be corrected algebraically with a separate ordinary q-even shear. A legal same-volume two-return service remains open. No physical candidate was built.

## Exact price and replay

Comparator #7334 at `aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace`, κ `0.00364665195644`; signed #7113 at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`. The full pre-support bill changes paid stock by P1−192 and P2+96 with unchanged productive stock. The gross upper is about 0.484699135287 raw for one edit, or 0.969398270574 for two disjoint edits. One added paid rank-one position defeats both through the retained BIT cap.

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-type-a-query-fixed-cut/replay.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-type-a-query-fixed-cut
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-type-a-query-fixed-cut --check-modes --check-source-history
```

All passed locally, including official export and replay without Git. Replay reconstructs eight receipts and rejects an altered caller. The branch includes the existing #7257 shared planner repair at `d2e54af81f9dda6487636b79d4964a2385d89b2b`. Without it the onboarding check fails on baseline documentation before package replay starts.

## Credit and next test

#7334 supplies the complete comparator, #7113 the signed caller and compiled binding, #7298 the directed tariff, #7309 the QUERY census and fixed-field exclusion, and #7310 the one-QUERY changed-J exclusion. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted. A distinct next mechanism tries to absorb both changed QUERYs into one already paid J. First test the exact relative phase rank at each of six QUERY pairs and 17 hosts before building anything. Rounds 76–77 are tracked in #7111.
